heading, To support individuals in the management of their long-term conditions, so they can live happier, healthier lives., level 3

We are a social-impact focused company, meaning we aim to create a positive difference in people's lives. Through personalised digital therapies, we provide support to individuals so that they can self-manage their long-term conditions and improve their overall wellbeing.
in order to provide individuals with the tools that they need to meet their long-term health and wellbeing goals with confidence.
heading, It is important to us that we continue to keep our values at the forefront of everything that we do., level 3
. But more importantly, individuals find their own confidence with our support.
We understand that each individual comes from a different background with a variety of unique needs. We ensure that
We are committed to doing our best to improve what we do and how we do it, to
always reflect and address the lived experiences

People living with long term inflammatory conditions, such as IBD and arthritis, often require scheduled check-ups and ongoing testing regiments. However, these appointments don’t always happen when someone needs them the most or when they are in flare.

Remote monitoring can lead to a reduction in unnecessary hospital visits, allowing individuals to be seen when they need it, for example during periods of relapse, rather than when they are feeling well.
By using remote monitoring tools, individuals are able to maintain a daily record of their condition, from physical symptoms to the feelings that they experience.
Doing so allows them to notice patterns between their symptoms and habits and provides their clinical teams with a better overview and understanding of what has happened between appointments.

heading, Each member of the Ampersand Health team is passionate about what they do and use their own unique skills and strengths to make a difference., level 3
We are a creative, determined and diverse team that share a common passion for helping others live a more positive, healthy and fulfilling life.
Part of our team is made up of clinicians, experts and patient groups, all of whom play a key role in the development of our digital therapies.
